newsitem.title: FRANCE: Broker sees 250 FFr target for Scor stock.
newsitem.headline: Broker sees 250 FFr target for Scor stock.

text.p: The stock of French reinsurer Scor, which gained on Tuesday after news that Swiss Re was buying reinsurer Mercantile & General from Prudential Corp, has the potential to rise to 250 francs a share, according to De Bouzet brokerage.

In a research note dated August 21, the brokerage, which is part of French bank BNP, says the stock's potential "lies more in its capacity to maintain already healthy profitability than in a takeover scenario in a sector where there cards have already been largely redealt."
"Our target for the stock of 250 francs values a potential rise of 30 percent," the brokerage's analysts said in the note.
Scor shares finished the day 4.2 francs, or 2.12 percent, up at 202 francs in a stock market, which ended marginally down.
